title: Safe and simple banking
tagline: Protected against fraud, savings working, family taken care of.
trigger: Retired customer with a suspicious new payee, or a large balance that isn't working.

steps.title: Check that last payment
steps.description: A first payment to an unknown company: KBC's fraud team checks it with you.
steps.why: KBC can still try to recall a payment if it was fraud.

win.customer: Money back if it was a scam

steps.result: The fraud team asked the receiving bank to block the payment to {new_payee}. You'll hear from us within 48 hours.

steps.title: Insurance against online fraud
steps.description: Cover if you are tricked into a payment, including phishing.
steps.why: Small premium, large peace of mind.

steps.title: Let your savings earn interest
steps.description: Money you don't need every month moves to a savings account. A buffer stays on your current account.
steps.why: Same bank, one tap, always available.
steps.result: €{idle_k}k moved to a savings account. €5k stays on your current account.

steps.title: Save for your grandchildren
steps.description: A savings account in a grandchild's name instead of envelopes with cash.
steps.why: You already give them gifts. This way the gift grows.
steps.result: Savings accounts opened for your two grandchildren: €20 a month each.

steps.title: Important papers in one safe place
steps.description: Your will, policies and pension letters in your digital vault and eBox, so your family can find them.

win.customer: Your family knows where to look

steps.result: Digital vault set up and eBox linked: pension and tax letters arrive there automatically.
